svg.title: Health Record Submission - Validation and Replacement

g.text: Health Record Submission - Validation and Replacement
Read submitted subject; trim to 150 characters
Require finite values, allowed ranges and integer steps
Parse ISO date; require subject and day <= today
Keep existing values; show replacement prompt
Redirect to query with kind and subject
Doc Pup fills browser controls only.
The same validation and persistence path runs
after the user reviews and submits the form.
